scope: Current operations behavior examples. Fixture names are stable labels, not prescribed internal API types. One group may be proven by one table-driven test. Named subcases share the parent case ID; all their effects must be checked.

cases.description: Active account acct-feedback-1 is Owner in Harvest Point. Submit twice with request key fb-1, category bug, description "Save button stops", page "Documents", address /documents?token=secret#draft, church Harvest Point, role Owner, browser Chrome 130 on macOS, screen 1440 x 900, theme dark, app version v3.0 and server time 2026-10-14T07:00:00Z. Try a screenshot field, another author's status ID and a suspended author.

checks: One private original contains category bug, description "Save button stops", page Documents, sanitized address /documents, trusted church Harvest Point and role Owner, browser Chrome 130 on macOS, screen 1440 x 900, dark theme, v3.0 and trusted submission time. The repeated key returns the original result; a screenshot/attachment field is refused without storing it. Public output contains only the approved category/product-area/fixed-text/random-marker summary, with no church, role or device details. Own status is bounded and excludes private details; foreign and suspended authors are denied. Stored is distinct from published or implemented.
